command: unset MSYS_NO_PATHCONV; corepack pnpm --filter @acs/web run 2>&1 | grep -E '^  [a-z]' ; echo '== test'; corepack pnpm -r --if-present test 2>&1 | grep -E 'Test Files|Tests ' ; echo '== lint'; corepack pnpm --filter @acs/web lint 2>&1 | tail -4; echo "lint=$?"; echo '== typecheck'; corepack pnpm --filter @acs/web typecheck 2>&1 | tail -4; echo '== format'; corepack pnpm format:check 2>&1 | grep warn; true
